title: Microsoft Purview DLP: stop Copilot grounding on external emails
summary: The briefing's control, default state, licensing statements and rollout dates are supported by Microsoft's documentation and notice. Two checklist items refer to controls absent from the controls table; these are minor corrections and do not prevent publication.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a real-time Purview DLP control preventing Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing external senders' emails.
claims.quote: This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The external-email preview article names no separate SKU.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Copilot external email DLP control separate toggle licensing price meter PowerShell external sender. Opened the full Copilot DLP article and Purview service description; the article links to general licensing and names no external-email SKU.

claims.claim: No meter is documented specifically for this external-email control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "external email" "DLP" "price" "meter". Read the Copilot DLP article, Purview service description and Copilot pay-as-you-go meters search excerpt; the meters cover agent usage, not this DLP control.

claims.claim: No separate price is documented for this control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "external email" "DLP" "price" "meter". Read the Copilot DLP article and Purview service description; search results give Copilot agent and Retrieval API prices but no external-email DLP price.

claims.claim: The policy location is reached in Microsoft Purview portal through Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom policy > Locations > Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork.
claims.quote:
Go to **Data Loss Prevention** > **Policies** and select **+ Create policy**.
3. Select the **Custom** template, then **Custom policy**.
4. On the **Locations** page, set the **Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork** location to on.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document PowerShell or other automation syntax configuring the external-email rule and action.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "external email" "PowerShell" "DLP". Opened New-DlpCompliancePolicy and New-DlpComplianceRule; searched Copilot, external, FromScope and processing. The policy example uses labels; FromScope is Exchange-only; no external-email Copilot rule syntax.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no separate tenant-wide toggle beyond the external-email condition within a DLP policy.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "external email" "toggle" "Purview". Opened the Copilot DLP article and read matching search excerpts; they describe a DLP policy condition, not a separate tenant toggle.

claims.claim: A policy-creation cmdlet is documented, distinct from the unpublished external-email rule syntax.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

claims.claim: This control excludes input content rather than introducing a new autonomous Copilot action.
claims.quote: Adds a new DLP control scoped specifically to Copilot and Copilot Chat grounding behavior.

claims.claim: A policy can govern this control across the tenant, with groups selected as appropriate.
claims.quote: An unrestricted administrator can scope policies to administrative units or keep **Full directory** to apply a policy across the organization.

claims.claim: The feature covers email summarisation and reasoning experiences using email data.
claims.quote: including email summarization and reasoning experiences that use email data.

claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to review accepted domains without a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Review your tenant's accepted domains, because the rule compares each sender's domain with them. / The only controls row is Whether Copilot excludes external senders' emails from grounding.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet 'Review your tenant's accepted domains, because the rule compares each sender's domain with them.' Keep the documented domain-comparison mechanism in What's changing.

claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to assign a policy-author role without a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Assign the policy author one of the roles listed under Scope, preferably the narrowest. / The only controls row is Whether Copilot excludes external senders' emails from grounding.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet 'Assign the policy author one of the roles listed under Scope, preferably the narrowest.' Keep the role prerequisites in Scope.
